name: Mukund
description: I'm a software developer and open-source contributor from India. Also, a Google Summer of Code 2026 contributor with FOSSASIA, working on TeamShifts, a team and volunteer management plugin for the Eventyay platform. I've been contributing to FOSSASIA for 9 months now. Alongside open source, I'm interested in software development, AI, and building practical technology projects. Through GSoC, I have explored what it means to work on a real-world project with an existing codebase and an international open-source community.
